title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful. I had a black and white marble countertop with new black faucets in my bathroom, this rug sets off the beauty of my bathroom. Just perfect for the look I wanted to create, it is beautiful. I also thank Amazon for saving me time and money by offering quality products to their members.

product_metadata.title: SUPERIOR Elegant Kingfield Collection Area Rug, 8mm Pile Height with Jute Backing, Classic Bordered Rug Design - Red, 4' x 6' Rug
features: QUALITY DETAILS: Crafted with premium 100% Polypropylene fibers; lovely.32” (8mm) soft pile height; plush underfoot yet stands up to high traffic
VARIETY OF SIZE: Enjoy Kingfield in scatter size 2’ x 3’, runner size 2’ 7” x 8’, and popular living room sizes 4’ x 6’, 5’ x 8’, or 8’ x 10’
CAPTIVATING STYLE: Kingfield displays a traditional floral-vine pattern with a matching border; available in your choice of slate, black, red or blue
CRAFTED TO LAST: Sturdy jute backing; rug pad recommended
EFFORTLESS CARE: Remove loose ends with scissors; Turn occasionally to equalize wear.
